snippet: The curmudgeonly giant dislikes both Christmas and cookies, but especially Christmas cookies. Can Ember bake a cookie delicious enough to change his mind? title: Krumblor - Cookie Clicker Wiki
snippet: Krumblor the cookie dragon is a widget that was added in v1.9 of the game. By sacrificing cookies and buildings to Krumblor, the player will unlock selectable auras which provide various benefits in the game. An aura can be selected by clicking on the dragon.
